stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_012; tran_son music + forge ambience are the furnace-and-hall cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this scene (S01: a large stone furnace at center, two workers seated on the wooden platform before it, charcoal, bamboo baskets and smithing tools at both sides, warm orange light, WIDE_STATIC; S02: Ha Mac at an archive desk laying a narrow paper strip across a line of the open recovered journal, a public-copy sheet at frame left and a string-tied sealed archive folder at frame right, scroll shelves behind him, DETAIL_LOCKED; S03: Ha Mac in a dark blue robe behind a long wooden table, two blank white papers, lantern-lit hall with mountains and pines through a large window, MEDIUM_STATIC; keyframes CIN_012 S01/S02/S03). tran_son is the composed set's bell-led stately form ('Tran Son — Nguoi qua cua': the bell states the motif, a low flute answers, a drum marks every bar line, 90 BPM) -- the measured, ceremonial weight of a decision taken in a lantern-lit hall ('Co the dua chuyen nay ra anh sang ma khong day nguoi lam chung vao lua'); forge is the fire bed (fire rumble + 180 crackle ticks + 5 metallic clinks) for the stone furnace and smithing tools of S01. sa_hoa ('Lo va cat') was passed over: it was just used for CIN_010 and its 110 BPM drive suits that desert scene better than this quiet moral line. The reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_012_timing_v1.json).
stemAssignment.alternateTakeExcluded: N/A: CIN_012 has no alternate take.

notes: VO window 12.5-17.5 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1. The window is the uniform 12.5-17.5 s (71 chars at 14.20 chars/s); it was NOT widened.

VO take runs 12.5-16.820 s: 4.320 s, ending 0.680 s BEFORE the 17.5 s window end -- the take FITS inside its window by 680 ms (no overrun, unlike CIN_005/CIN_006). The take ends 1.180 s before the 18.00 s scene end, so no tail trim at the scene edge. The window, the take and the timing are unchanged.
The CP17 VO take measures -25.38 LUFS (checkpoint 17, re-verified from real bytes this run, vs -21.50 LUFS for the CIN_011 take). VO is kept at unity per the recipe, not normalized.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009/CIN_010/CIN_011/CIN_012 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
